actions.old_string:
(r'\s+', Text),
            (r'#\[', Punctuation, 'attribute'),
            (r'#.*?\n', Comment.Single),
            # put the empty comment here, it is otherwise seen as
            # the start of a docstring
            (r'/\*\*/', Comment.Multiline),
            (r'/\*\*.*?\*/', String.Doc),
            (r'/\*.*?\*/', Comment.Multiline),
actions.new_string:
(r'\s+', Text),
            (r'#\[', Punctuation, 'attribute'),
            (r'#.*?\n', Comment.Single),
            (r'//.*?\n', Comment.Single),
            # put the empty comment here, it is otherwise seen as
            # the start of a docstring
            (r'/\*\*/', Comment.Multiline),
            (r'/\*\*.*?\*/', String.Doc),
            (r'/\*.*?\*/', Comment.Multiline),

actions.old_string:
(r'[\[\]{}();,]+', Punctuation),
            (r'(class)(\s+)', bygroups(Keyword, Text), 'classname'),
            (r'(function)(\s*)(?=\()', bygroups(Keyword, Text)),
            (r'(function)(\s+)(&?)(\s*)',
             bygroups(Keyword, Text, Operator, Text), 'functionname'),
actions.new_string:
(r'[\[\]{}();,]+', Punctuation),
            (r'(class)(\s+)', bygroups(Keyword, Text), 'classname'),
            (r'(new)(\s+)(class)(\s*)(?=\(|\{)',
             bygroups(Keyword, Text, Keyword, Text)),
            (r'(function)(\s*)(?=\()', bygroups(Keyword, Text)),
            (r'(function)(\s+)(&?)(\s*)',
             bygroups(Keyword, Text, Operator, Text), 'functionname'),
